desc: Newspaper advertisement regarding 51st AGM of the Company to be held through Two Way Video Conferencing ("VC") / Other Audio Visual Means ("OAVM") on Wednesday, September 23, 2026 at 4:00 P.M. (IST).
Please find enclosed Notice of the 51st Annual General Meeting of the Company scheduled to be held on Wednesday, September 23, 2026 at 4:00 P.M. (IST) through Two way VC/OAVM.
Please find enclosed herewith the Annual Report for FY 2025-26.
Please find attached herewith the Business Responsibility and Sustainability Report ("BRSR") of the Company for FY 2025-26. The said BRSR is submitted voluntarily by the Company.
Letter sent to the concerned Shareholders providing web-link, including exact path, for accessing the Annual Report FY 2025-26
Newspaper publication regarding Notice of 51st Annual General Meeting, Remote E-voting, Cut-Off Date & Record Date.
